name: Mengheng (Kyle) Lee
summary: Results-driven DevOps and backend engineer with a proven track record of optimizing software development workflows, automating infrastructure, and leading high-impact engineering initiatives. Currently a DevOps Consultant at AWS Japan, specializing in CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and scalable deployment strategies. Recent achievements include co-designing a horizontal autoscaling CI/CD VM runner, introducing reusable GitHub Actions to reduce pipeline setup time by 50%, and reducing cloud computing costs by over 50% with event-driven autoscaling. Skilled in Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions, and cloud platforms (Azure, GCP, AWS), with a deep focus on efficiency, automation, and clean architecture. Passionate about solving complex technical challenges, reducing technical debt, and enabling teams to ship faster and more reliably.
